张焱：如今，人工智能对设计领域教学带来挑战，与其被动应变，不如精准识变、主动求变: Zhang Yan: Nowadays, artificial intelligence presents challenges to design education. Rather than passively adapting, it is better to precisely identify changes and proactively seek transformation.
学生可以从设计师成长为指挥人工智能的设计总监，负责提出问题、监控设计过程、评价设: Students can grow from designers into design directors who command artificial intelligence, responsible for raising questions, monitoring the design process, and evaluating design results.

我讲授“软件工程”课十几年了，近几年，人工智能编程工具快速发展，同学们可以通过自: I have taught the "Software Engineering" course for over a decade. In recent years, artificial intelligence programming tools have developed rapidly, and students can generate code through natural language dialogue.
这学期，几乎所有小组都在用人工智能工具辅助完成课程项目任务，甚至可以单人完成，无: This semester, nearly all groups are using artificial intelligence tools to assist in completing course project tasks, and some can even be completed by a single person, without needing group collaboration.
我没有阻挡学生用人工智能，反而在第一节课就鼓励他们使用，同时强调人工智能在复杂软: I did not prevent students from using artificial intelligence; instead, I encouraged them to use it in the first class, while emphasizing the limitations of artificial intelligence in complex software development and guiding students to use it reasonably.
其实，人工智能的发展使得写代码不再是软件开发的主要难题，而需求分析、设计规划、验: In fact, the development of artificial intelligence has made writing code no longer the main challenge in software development. Instead, higher-order engineering capabilities such as requirements analysis, design planning, and verification confirmation have become more important, and these are also the focus of our teaching.
当人工智能也能写作，人还需不需要学习写作: When artificial intelligence can also write, do humans still need to learn writing?
如果写作课的目标仅仅停留在让学生更快更多地产出基准线水平的文章，那么这门课在人工: If the goal of writing courses merely remains at enabling students to produce more baseline-level articles faster, then the value of this course in the age of artificial intelligence will be greatly diminished.
人工智能对这门“老课”也带来冲击，学生的困惑非常直接：人类译员会被人工智能取代吗: Artificial intelligence also brings challenges to this "old course." Students' confusion is very direct: Will human translators be replaced by artificial intelligence?
目标也不只是教会学生翻译，而是培养善于指挥“人工智能译员”完成复杂翻译任务、定义: The goal is not merely to teach students translation, but to cultivate experts skilled at commanding "AI translators" to complete complex translation tasks and define translation quality.
人工智能负责低阶任务，师生专注于高阶思维活动: Artificial intelligence handles low-order tasks, while teachers and students focus on high-order intellectual activities.

Regardless of which method was used, students were dissatisfied with the AI translations and universally made revisions.
记者：有了人工智能加入，课堂中的角色关系如何从师生协同走向人机协同: Reporter: With artificial intelligence joining in, how should the role relationships in the classroom transition from teacher-student collaboration to human-machine collaboration?
敖缦云：课上，我主动把人工智能变成教学的一部分，从这些年接到的翻译、审校任务中，: Ao Manyun: In class, I proactively made artificial intelligence part of the teaching process. From the translation and proofreading tasks I have received in recent years, I selected classical works such as the Laozi and audiovisual works such as "Journey to the West," "Lingshan," and "Nezha Reborn" as teaching cases, guiding students to learn human-machine collaboration through real and complex translation tasks.
给人工智能“找茬”“挑错”时，同学们参与度很高，批判性思维也被激发出来: When students "find faults" and "point out errors" in artificial intelligence, their participation is very high and their critical thinking is stimulated.
那些大模型“翻不明白”的地方，反而成为课上最有价值的教学内容: Those places where the large model "cannot understand clearly" actually become the most valuable teaching content in class.
李轶男：写作课团队与清华的技术团队开发了智能体，可以作为学生的智能学伴，进行智能: Li Yinan: The writing course team worked with Tsinghua's technical team to develop an intelligent agent that can serve as an intelligent learning companion for students, providing intelligent comments and feedback.
课上的朋辈互评环节，我首先请同学们阅读彼此的文章，然后请人工智能给出批注，再请同: In the peer review session in class, I first ask students to read each other's articles, then ask artificial intelligence to provide comments, and then ask students to "re-comment" on the AI's suggestions.
这实质上也是批判性思考的过程，同学们会意识到人工智能给出的答案并不能全盘接受，也: This is essentially a process of critical thinking. Students will come to realize that the answers provided by artificial intelligence cannot be entirely accepted, and they will appreciate the importance of human holistic judgment.
记者：课后作业环节，如何引导学生合理使用人工智能: Reporter: In the homework section, how do you guide students to use artificial intelligence reasonably?

如果作业设计得不好，学生可以从头到尾用人工智能搞定，那学习效果可能受影响: If assignments are poorly designed, students can rely entirely on artificial intelligence from start to finish, and the learning effect may be compromised.
有了人工智能帮助，大家可以完成规模更大、难度更高的任务，同时，我们也提高了对学生: With artificial intelligence's help, everyone can complete larger-scale and more difficult tasks. At the same time, we have raised our expectations for students.
李轶男：写作课要求教师与每名同学进行两轮一对一“面批”，教师不仅与学生探讨人工智: Li Yinan: The writing course requires teachers to conduct two rounds of one-on-one face-to-face reviews with each student. Teachers not only discuss with students the strategies and effects of artificial intelligence use, but also require students to reflect on their own learning process.

耿乐乐：人工智能应成为教师教学过程中的助手、学生学习过程中的伙伴: Geng Lele: Artificial intelligence should become a helper in the teacher's teaching process and a partner in the student's learning process.
人机协同教学中，人工智能可以负责事实检索、模式识别等相对低阶的任务，师生则专注于: In human-machine collaborative teaching, artificial intelligence can be responsible for relatively low-order tasks such as fact retrieval and pattern recognition, while teachers and students focus on high-order intellectual activities such as value judgment and logical questioning.
学生可以先利用人工智能获取初步答案，再通过追问、验证等提高元认知能力: Students can first use artificial intelligence to obtain preliminary answers, then enhance their metacognitive abilities through follow-up questions and verification.
要防止盲目信任人工智能输出，避免技术依赖导致思维惰性，确保人机协同服务于批判性思: We must prevent blind trust in artificial intelligence output, avoid technology dependence leading to mental laziness, and ensure that human-machine collaboration serves the cultivation of critical thinking.

张焱：当人工智能将学生从重复性的设计表现工作中解放出来，我们更加注重引导学生提升: Zhang Yan: When artificial intelligence frees students from repetitive design and presentation work, we place greater emphasis on guiding students to enhance their ability to discover problems grounded in 'empathy,' their ability to analyze problems grounded in logic, their ability to innovate in design and convert to industry grounded in scientific methods, and so on.
耿乐乐：人工智能时代，高阶思维能力，包括批判性思考、逻辑推理等格外重要: Geng Lele: In the age of artificial intelligence, higher-order thinking abilities, including critical thinking and logical reasoning, are particularly important.
